data.task_title: Create Artemis self-demo with Chart.js visualization

features.title: Real-Time Metrics Dashboard
features.description: Develop a real-time dashboard showcasing live metrics with Chart.js.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard displays LLM cost over time with a line chart.
Stage completion rates are shown with a bar chart.
Success rate trends are visualized with an area chart.

features.title: Chart.js Visualizations
features.description: Integrate Chart.js to display various metrics and data visualizations in the presentation.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline metrics are visualized using Chart.js.
Cost tracking and success rates are displayed with charts.
Charts include line, bar, area, pie, and radar types.

features.title: Showcase Real Metrics
features.description: Include real metrics from recent runs in the presentation.
acceptance_criteria: Metrics are up-to-date and accurate.
Data is presented in a clear and understandable manner.
Charts and graphs reflect actual performance data.

features.title: Code Quality Metrics
features.description: Display code quality metrics such as TDD compliance and SOLID principles using a radar chart.
acceptance_criteria: Code quality metrics are shown with a radar chart.
The chart includes TDD compliance and SOLID principles.
Data is accurate and reflective of recent runs.

features.title: Integration Visualization
features.description: Show integration of supervisor across stages using a pie chart.
acceptance_criteria: Integration is visualized with a pie chart.
The chart accurately represents integration data.
The visualization is clear and easy to understand.

features.title: Standalone HTML Presentation
features.description: Create a single HTML file with embedded CSS, JavaScript, and Chart.js for the Artemis demo.
acceptance_criteria: The HTML file is standalone with no external dependencies.
CSS and JavaScript are embedded within the HTML.
Chart.js is included for data visualization.

features.title: HERO Section: Introduction to Artemis
features.description: Create an introductory slide explaining what Artemis is.
acceptance_criteria: The HERO slide clearly explains Artemis as an Autonomous AI Development System.
The slide is visually engaging.
Key features of Artemis are highlighted.

features.title: Auto-Advance and Navigation Controls
features.description: Enable auto-advance of slides with user navigation controls.
acceptance_criteria: Slides auto-advance after a set duration.
Users can manually navigate between slides.
Navigation controls are intuitive and responsive.

features.title: Professional Design and Transitions
features.description: Implement a professional gradient background and smooth slide transitions.
acceptance_criteria: The presentation has a gradient background.
Slide transitions are smooth and professional.
Design elements are consistent with a professional theme.
